title: Scaling of `underlyingTokenPrice` will leave funds stuck in protocol
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, as all deposited funds will be stuck in the protocol  **Likelihood:** High, as it will always happen  ## Description  The `_getTokenPrices` method in `SwapFacility` has the following code:  ```solidity underlyingTokenPrice =     uint256(IOracle(underlyingTokenOracle).latestAnswer()) *     1e12; ```  This scaling by `1e12` is an error, because most oracle price feeds in Chainlink (and more specifically, the one that is expected to be used, `USDC/USD`) return an 8 decimals number.
